explanationBullets: No exact family match was found, so the generic router guide is the safest fallback.
Use menu aliases such as NAT Forwarding, Virtual Server, Applications & Gaming, Port Rules, Firewall Rules, or Advanced NAT while you search the router interface.

notes: "net" (from P1.10's already-verified matcher fixtures) gives netgear-router a topCandidate via plain keyword prefix/substring, but matchedDirectGuide is false (no family alias, no exact keyword) and inferredFamilies is empty — so *neither* the topCandidate branch nor the inferredFamilies branch returns, and control falls all the way past the `if !query.isEmpty` block to the networkType switch. With networkType nil and every flag false, query.isEmpty is the only thing that would route to unknownRouterHelp, and query ("net") isn't empty — so this lands on plain genericRouterResolution despite being a non-empty, non-trivial search.
